results.command:
set -eu
test ! -e /opt/docker/homarr
install -d -m 0755 /opt/docker/homarr
cd /opt/docker/homarr
cat > docker-compose.yml <<'HOMARR_COMPOSE'
services:
  homarr:
    container_name: homarr
    image: ghcr.io/homarr-labs/homarr:v1.77.2
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "192.168.40.35:7575:7575"
    volumes:
      - ./appdata:/appdata
    environment:
      SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY:?Set SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY in .env}
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"
HOMARR_COMPOSE
umask 077
python3 - <<'PY'
import secrets
with open('.env','x') as f:
    f.write('SECRET_ENCRYPTION_KEY='+secrets.token_hex(32)+'\n')
print('Encryption key generated in mode-0600 .env')
PY
docker compose config --quiet
docker compose pull --quiet
docker compose up -d
docker compose ps
